newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico says sold all dlr options of offer.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico says sold all dlr options of offer.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said on Friday that it sold all $200 million in dollar put options available for the coming month of September.

The central bank said the average premium paid by banks was 4.65 pesos per $1,000, compared with 11.68 pesos per $1,000 paid during the central bank's first auction of $130 million in options in early August.
The dollar put option plan is a means for the central bank to build reserves during times of peso strength. All $130 million in options sold during the first auction were exercised by the holders.
